courses.name: Bachelor's in Forestry
courses.summary: This catalogue category covers undergraduate degrees in forestry, usually three or four years after an upper-secondary qualification with biology or agriculture. Typical curricula cover forest ecology, silviculture, tree improvement, forest mensuration, wildlife and biodiversity management, agroforestry and forest policy, with field work in forests, nurseries and plantations.

courses.name: Bachelor's in Nutrition and Dietetics
courses.summary: Undergraduate study of human nutrition, dietetics, food science and the relationship between diet and health. Course structures and professional practice requirements differ by institution and jurisdiction.
courses.metaTitle: Bachelor's in Nutrition and Dietetics Degrees
courses.metaDescription: Compare Bachelor's in Nutrition and Dietetics by duration, academic requirements, teaching language, tuition status and programme structure.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Agricultural Engineering
courses.summary: The Students Traffic catalogue category for four-year undergraduate agricultural engineering degrees. Programmes in this category apply engineering to farming and food production: farm machinery and power, soil and water conservation, irrigation and drainage, post-harvest and processing engineering and renewable energy in agriculture, with field and workshop practice. Curriculum, regulator approval, admission route and fees are set by each awarding university, so the programme record should drive a shortlist decision.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech Agricultural Programmes | Students Traffic
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech Agricultural engineering programmes by curriculum, approvals, admission route, teaching language and fee status before you apply.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Biotechnology
courses.summary: The B.E./B.Tech in Biotechnology is an undergraduate engineering degree that applies engineering principles to living systems. Students study biochemistry, microbiology, molecular biology and genetic engineering alongside bioprocess engineering, fermentation technology, downstream processing, bioinformatics and engineering mathematics, with substantial laboratory work and an industry or research project. It is usually a four-year programme entered after secondary school with physics, chemistry and mathematics or biology. Graduates work in biopharmaceutical, food, agricultural and environmental biotechnology or continue to M.Tech or research study.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech Biotechnology for International Students
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech Biotechnology degrees open to international students: curriculum, entry subjects, duration, tuition and intakes.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Environmental Engineering
aliases: Bachelor of Technology in Environmental Engineering
courses.summary: The B.E./B.Tech in Environmental Engineering is an undergraduate engineering degree in protecting air, water and land and designing sustainable infrastructure. The curriculum combines engineering mathematics, fluid mechanics and chemistry with water and wastewater treatment, air-pollution control, solid-waste management, environmental impact assessment, hydrology and sustainability, supported by laboratory work and design projects. It usually lasts four years after secondary school with physics, chemistry and mathematics. Graduates work in environmental consultancy, utilities, regulators and industry or continue to postgraduate study.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech Environmental Engineering Degrees
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech Environmental Engineering degrees open to international students: curriculum, entry subjects, duration and tuition.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Food Technology
aliases: Bachelor of Technology in Food Processing Technology
courses.summary: Undergraduate food technology engineering degrees examine food processing, preservation, production systems, quality control and safety. Science and engineering coursework is combined with laboratory, plant-design or product-development work.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech Food Technology Degrees for International Students
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech Food Technology degrees: duration, teaching language, intake, tuition and each university’s specific admission and applicant-category rules.

The exact curriculum, admission route and professional scope vary by institution. Compare school subjects and marks, entrance requirements, teaching language, campus, duration, practical assessment and complete study costs.

Study connects production systems with supply chains and commercial decisions. Compare the agricultural science content, practical training and admission subjects with business administration degrees before choosing a course.

It suits graduates in mechanical, electrical or chemical engineering or the physical sciences. The degree normally lasts two years and leads to roles in renewable-energy development, utilities and energy consultancy, or to research.

universities.name: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University
universities.summary: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University is a public state university headquartered in Coimbatore. Agriculture, horticulture, forestry, food, engineering and agribusiness study is distributed across constituent campuses. Undergraduate applicants choose a course and college; postgraduate study combines coursework with thesis research and university-assigned locations.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Coimbatore headquarters is on Lawley Road. Constituent colleges operate across Tamil Nadu, so an allotted course does not automatically mean living in Coimbatore. Farm practicals, laboratories and fieldwork are part of agricultural study; the main-campus student guidance describes early-morning farm practicals and compulsory practical uniforms.
universities.cityProfile: Coimbatore is the university’s headquarters. Other constituent locations include Madurai, Killikulam, Tiruchirappalli, Kumulur, Periyakulam, Mettupalayam and district campuses. Plan travel and housing around the actual allotted college. Postgraduate research can take place at another campus, research station or Krishi Vigyan Kendra.
universities.practicalExposure: Undergraduate study combines classroom teaching with farm and laboratory practicals. Master’s and doctoral programmes require coursework and thesis research. Postgraduate students may be assigned different teaching and research locations; the exact discipline and supervisory allocation determine the research setting.
universities.hostelOverview: The main campus has separate men’s and women’s hostels and the Norman Borlaug International Hostel. Reading rooms, study rooms and dining facilities are available. Postgraduate hostel accommodation is limited and subject to availability; admission does not create a right to a hostel place. Confirm housing at the actual allotted campus.
universities.dietarySupport: Main-campus hostel residents must join the mess. Vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals are served through student-run dividing-system messes monitored by wardens; charges vary with meal costs. A cafeteria and refreshment facilities also serve students. Confirm arrangements and costs for constituent campuses separately.
universities.safetyOverview: Main-campus hostels are supervised by wardens, deputy wardens and residential tutors. Hostel discipline and permission rules apply. Ragging is prohibited across constituent and affiliated campuses; programme and accommodation admission do not remove these conduct requirements.
universities.studentSupport: Academic counselling, hostel supervision and university grievance channels support students. The Centre for Students Welfare coordinates placement activity, while the International Cell supports eligible study-abroad progression. Students Traffic can help match course, campus, entry route and full-cost requirements.

faq.question: Is TNAU a public university?
faq.answer: TNAU is a public state agricultural university established in 1971, with its headquarters in Coimbatore. A constituent college belongs to the university; a privately managed affiliated college is a separate institution with its own admission and cost context.

faq.question: Are all courses taught in English?
faq.answer: The regular undergraduate programmes use English except for the separately selected Tamil-medium Agriculture and Horticulture routes at Coimbatore. Postgraduate instruction is English, with adequate reading, writing, speaking and research English required. A Tamil-medium seat is a distinct course choice.

faq.question: How do undergraduate applicants qualify?
faq.answer: Applicants need the exact four school subjects and category-specific aggregate for their chosen course. General counselling uses Tamil Nadu nativity or the prescribed Classes 10–12 study condition, age and attempt limits. Other quotas must be assessed through their own rules.

faq.question: Do I need NEET or JEE for TNAU UG counselling?
faq.answer: The TNAU general undergraduate route uses qualifying-school marks and counselling, without a separate university entrance examination. ICAR and special quotas are separate admission routes; they must not be confused with the general counselling process.

faq.question: Can I choose the campus?
faq.answer: UG applicants rank the exact course and college during counselling. After admission, course and campus transfers are not permitted. Postgraduate coursework and research locations are assigned by the university and can differ from one another.

faq.question: What does the tuition amount exclude?
faq.answer: The 2026–27 UG tuition line is INR 4,500 per semester and the master’s line INR 4,950. Other semester charges, compulsory self-supporting additions, one-time fees, deposits and living costs are separate. Use the full admission-category budget, rather than tuition alone.

faq.question: Are NRI charges the same as domestic tuition?
faq.answer: No. The 2026 UG NRI quota bills an aggregate USD 3,300 semester fee and requires sponsor, embassy and relationship documentation. That aggregate is not a verified foreign tuition-only figure; Study in India and ICCR applicants need their awarded category and written offer.

faq.question: How does master’s selection work?
faq.answer: Applicants submit the exact qualifying farm-science degree records and take the university’s subject entrance examination in Coimbatore. A separate DBT-supported GAT-B route exists for Molecular Biology and Biotechnology, retaining its academic eligibility. Final original-document verification is required.

faq.question: What prior study is required for a doctorate?
faq.answer: The regular route requires the specified four-year farm-science/allied bachelor’s and two-year master’s pathway, with a master’s OGPA of at least 7.00/10.00. Each discipline has its own accepted master’s awards. The minimum residential period is three years, with a seven-year maximum under the 2025 rules.

faq.question: What are the verified intake dates?
faq.answer: The 2026 UG first-year plan used September; it is a historical planned baseline. The current master’s brochure plans first-semester registration on 9 October 2026 and the doctoral brochure on 22 December 2026. Future applicants need the next cohort’s notice.

faq.question: Does admission guarantee accommodation?
faq.answer: No. Postgraduate hostel places are limited and allocated subject to availability. The main campus has separate men’s and women’s accommodation, while constituent-campus arrangements need to be considered at the actual study location.

faq.question: What does the accreditation cover?
faq.answer: UGC lists TNAU as a State University. ICAR’s current register gives A+ accreditation from 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2028 and specifies its college and programme coverage. It does not automatically give every affiliated college or newly listed programme the same accreditation.

fee.notes: 2026–27 domestic tuition is INR 4,500 per semester; INR 9,000 annual tuition is two-semester arithmetic. The admission semester total is INR 23,000, including tuition and other charges; the even-semester tour charge falls from INR 2,500 to INR 300, while the INR 100 calendar charge applies in odd semesters. One-time admission items total INR 10,925 for Tamil Nadu HSC or INR 11,325 for CBSE/ICSE-equivalent, plus INR 750 sports development after registration. Hostel and mess are separate. The NRI quota bills USD 3,300 per semester as an aggregate semester fee, not a verified tuition-only figure; embassy proof and sponsorship conditions apply.

eligibleAudiences: Applicants meeting the programme-specific qualification and admission-category conditions
restrictions: Accepted school combinations: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology; OR Physics, Chemistry and Biology with one of Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Computer Science, Information Technology, Informatics Practices, Home Science, Agriculture, Horticulture or Environmental Science; OR Physics, Chemistry, Botany and Zoology.

The qualification and marks above describe the Tamil Nadu general academic counselling route. ICAR national counselling and special quotas have their own category allocation and document requirements.
Course and campus cannot be transferred after admission; the allotted constituent college determines attendance and residence.

Vocational alternatives: Biology plus Agricultural Practices theory and practical; OR Biology, Agricultural Science Theory, Agricultural Science Practical and Computer Technology; OR the same Biology/Agricultural Science subjects with Employability Skills. This separate quota does not enter general or other special reservation categories; the same applicable four-subject marks and age limits apply.

The campus/course has an NRI quota. The candidate must be an NRI, ward or close direct relative of an NRI, with sponsor passport/visa, Indian Embassy NRI proof and notarised relationship affidavit. OCI/residence or employment documents alone are not accepted as NRI proof. Confirm nativity and nationality applicability before choosing that route.

The 2026 campus/course seat table includes Study in India places for foreign students through ICCR. Exact foreign qualifying-subject equivalence, nomination and tuition category require the written foreign offer; domestic criteria and fees are not automatically applicable.

eligibility.intro: Apply the degree or school-subject requirements, marks, applicant category and selection route together. The precise alternatives and restrictions are part of eligibility.
items: Pass every subject in a recognised 10+2 academic examination with the programme’s required subject combination.
General counselling: Tamil Nadu nativity; applicants who studied Classes 10–12 in Tamil Nadu may enter the Open category with valid proof.
Four-subject aggregate: OC 55%; BC/BCM 50%; MBC/DNC 45%; SC/SCA/ST a pass in all required subjects.
On 1 July 2026, age must be below 21; no age limit for SC/SCA/ST and five years relaxation for differently abled applicants.
Qualifying-exam attempts: up to three for SC/SCA/ST and two for other communities. Additional subjects and grace marks do not enter ranking.
Selection uses the eligible school-subject aggregate and counselling; no separate TNAU undergraduate entrance examination.
A separate 5% Tamil Nadu vocational-stream quota applies to this course; other-state or other-board vocational qualifications are not accepted.

applicationSteps: Register in TNAU’s joint UG application portal and choose the exact TNAU constituent college, course and medium.
Upload qualifying subject marks and identity, nativity and relevant category records; pay the applicable application fee.
Participate in the specified counselling route, accept the allotment, pay the required amount and attend original-certificate verification.
Complete the allotted college’s joining and semester registration instructions; arrange accommodation and the full mandatory fee budget.

eligibility.intro: Apply the degree or school-subject requirements, marks, applicant category and selection route together. The precise alternatives and restrictions are part of eligibility.
items: Qualifying study must follow 10+2+4: a four-year farm-science or allied bachelor’s degree.
The prescribed degree must be from a State Agricultural University, ICAR institute, Central Agricultural University or Government-aided agricultural college.
Bachelor’s OGPA at least 3.00/4.00 or 6.60/10.00; SC/ST candidates need 6.50/10.00. The same conditions apply to ICAR-allotted candidates.
Use the programme-specific qualifying degree alternatives below; a similarly named general science or business degree is not automatically accepted.
Selection is through the TNAU subject entrance examination, held physically at Coimbatore: one hour, 100 marks (75 subject, 15 general agriculture, 10 aptitude).
Final-semester applicants may upload completed-semester records, but must present the degree/provisional certificate at admission.

applicationSteps: Apply through TNAU’s School of Post Graduate Studies portal and select the exact eligible subject; master’s applicants may choose up to two eligible subjects with separate fees.
Upload the required qualifying records and category documents; initial scrutiny determines entrance-test eligibility.
Attend the prescribed subject entrance examination at Coimbatore, or follow the separately approved GAT-B route for its named programme.
After selection, pay by the notified deadline, surrender original documents and register for the semester at the assigned campus.

evidence.claimText: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture is a four-year, eight-semester constituent-college course at AC & RI, Coimbatore. Choose this exact course, campus and teaching language during TNAU counselling; an affiliated-college seat is a different choice.
evidence.sourceLabel: 2026 official admission brochure and degree structure

evidence.claimText: Pass every subject in a recognised 10+2 academic examination with the programme’s required subject combination. General counselling: Tamil Nadu nativity; applicants who studied Classes 10–12 in Tamil Nadu may enter the Open category with valid proof. Four-subject aggregate: OC 55%; BC/BCM 50%; MBC/DNC 45%; SC/SCA/ST a pass in all required subjects. On 1 July 2026, age must be below 21; no age limit for SC/SCA/ST and five years relaxation for differently abled applicants. Qualifying-exam attempts: up to three for SC/SCA/ST and two for other communities. Additional subjects and grace marks do not enter ranking. Selection uses the eligible school-subject aggregate and counselling; no separate TNAU undergraduate entrance examination. A separate 5% Tamil Nadu vocational-stream quota applies to this course; other-state or other-board vocational qualifications are not accepted. Accepted school combinations: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology; OR Physics, Chemistry and Biology with one of Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Computer Science, Information Technology,
Informatics Practices, Home Science, Agriculture, Horticulture or Environmental Science; OR Physics, Chemistry, Botany and Zoology.

Accepted school combinations: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology; OR Physics, Chemistry and Biology with one of Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Computer Science, Information Technology, Informatics Practices, Home Science, Agriculture, Horticulture or Environmental Science; OR Physics, Chemistry, Botany and Zoology. The qualification and marks above describe the Tamil Nadu general academic counselling route. ICAR national counselling and special quotas have their own category allocation and document requirements. Course and campus cannot be transferred after admission; the allotted constituent college determines attendance and residence. Vocational alternatives: Biology plus Agricultural Practices theory and practical; OR Biology, Agricultural Science Theory, Agricultural Science Practical and Computer Technology; OR the same Biology/Agricultural Science subjects with Employability Skills. This separate quota does not enter general or other special reservation categories; the same applicable four-subject marks and age limits apply. The campus/course has an NRI
evidence.sourceLabel: Exact admission route and campus limits

Exact foreign qualifying-subject equivalence, nomination and tuition category require the written foreign offer; domestic criteria and fees are not automatically applicable.

Is TNAU a public university? TNAU is a public state agricultural university established in 1971, with its headquarters in Coimbatore. A constituent college belongs to the university; a privately managed affiliated college is a separate institution with its own admission and cost context.

Are all courses taught in English? The regular undergraduate programmes use English except for the separately selected Tamil-medium Agriculture and Horticulture routes at Coimbatore. Postgraduate instruction is English, with adequate reading, writing, speaking and research English required. A Tamil-medium seat is a distinct course choice.

How do undergraduate applicants qualify? Applicants need the exact four school subjects and category-specific aggregate for their chosen course. General counselling uses Tamil Nadu nativity or the prescribed Classes 10–12 study condition, age and attempt limits. Other quotas must be assessed through their own rules.

Do I need NEET or JEE for TNAU UG counselling? The TNAU general undergraduate route uses qualifying-school marks and counselling, without a separate university entrance examination. ICAR and special quotas are separate admission routes; they must not be confused with the general counselling process.

Can I choose the campus? UG applicants rank the exact course and college during counselling. After admission, course and campus transfers are not permitted. Postgraduate coursework and research locations are assigned by the university and can differ from one another.

What does the tuition amount exclude? The 2026–27 UG tuition line is INR 4,500 per semester and the master’s line INR 4,950. Other semester charges, compulsory self-supporting additions, one-time fees, deposits and living costs are separate. Use the full admission-category budget, rather than tuition alone.

Are NRI charges the same as domestic tuition? No. The 2026 UG NRI quota bills an aggregate USD 3,300 semester fee and requires sponsor, embassy and relationship documentation. That aggregate is not a verified foreign tuition-only figure; Study in India and ICCR applicants need their awarded category and written offer.

How does master’s selection work? Applicants submit the exact qualifying farm-science degree records and take the university’s subject entrance examination in Coimbatore. A separate DBT-supported GAT-B route exists for Molecular Biology and Biotechnology, retaining its academic eligibility. Final original-document verification is required.

What prior study is required for a doctorate? The regular route requires the specified four-year farm-science/allied bachelor’s and two-year master’s pathway, with a master’s OGPA of at least 7.00/10.00. Each discipline has its own accepted master’s awards. The minimum residential period is three years, with a seven-year maximum under the 2025 rules.

What are the verified intake dates? The 2026 UG first-year plan used September; it is a historical planned baseline. The current master’s brochure plans first-semester registration on 9 October 2026 and the doctoral brochure on 22 December 2026. Future applicants need the next cohort’s notice.

Does admission guarantee accommodation? No. Postgraduate hostel places are limited and allocated subject to availability. The main campus has separate men’s and women’s accommodation, while constituent-campus arrangements need to be considered at the actual study location.

What does the accreditation cover? UGC lists TNAU as a State University. ICAR’s current register gives A+ accreditation from 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2028 and specifies its college and programme coverage. It does not automatically give every affiliated college or newly listed programme the same accreditation.

Tamil Nadu Agricultural University is a public state university headquartered in Coimbatore. Agriculture, horticulture, forestry, food, engineering and agribusiness study is distributed across constituent campuses. Undergraduate applicants choose a course and college; postgraduate study combines coursework with thesis research and university-assigned locations.

The Coimbatore headquarters is on Lawley Road. Constituent colleges operate across Tamil Nadu, so an allotted course does not automatically mean living in Coimbatore. Farm practicals, laboratories and fieldwork are part of agricultural study; the main-campus student guidance describes early-morning farm practicals and compulsory practical uniforms.

Coimbatore is the university’s headquarters. Other constituent locations include Madurai, Killikulam, Tiruchirappalli, Kumulur, Periyakulam, Mettupalayam and district campuses. Plan travel and housing around the actual allotted college. Postgraduate research can take place at another campus, research station or Krishi Vigyan Kendra.

Undergraduate study combines classroom teaching with farm and laboratory practicals. Master’s and doctoral programmes require coursework and thesis research. Postgraduate students may be assigned different teaching and research locations; the exact discipline and supervisory allocation determine the research setting.

The main campus has separate men’s and women’s hostels and the Norman Borlaug International Hostel. Reading rooms, study rooms and dining facilities are available. Postgraduate hostel accommodation is limited and subject to availability; admission does not create a right to a hostel place. Confirm housing at the actual allotted campus.

Main-campus hostel residents must join the mess. Vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals are served through student-run dividing-system messes monitored by wardens; charges vary with meal costs. A cafeteria and refreshment facilities also serve students. Confirm arrangements and costs for constituent campuses separately.

Main-campus hostels are supervised by wardens, deputy wardens and residential tutors. Hostel discipline and permission rules apply. Ragging is prohibited across constituent and affiliated campuses; programme and accommodation admission do not remove these conduct requirements.

Academic counselling, hostel supervision and university grievance channels support students. The Centre for Students Welfare coordinates placement activity, while the International Cell supports eligible study-abroad progression. Students Traffic can help match course, campus, entry route and full-cost requirements.
